capabilities.name: ask

capabilities.name: browser

capabilities.name: browser-extension
capabilities.description: Control the user's connected Chrome/Brave browser via the Wolffish extension — navigate pages, click elements, fill forms, take screenshots, read content, manage tabs, and execute JavaScript in the user's real browser session.

capabilities.name: cloudflared

capabilities.name: computer-use

capabilities.name: document
capabilities.description: Read, create, modify, convert, and merge documents (docx, html, markdown, plain text)

capabilities.name: ffmpeg

capabilities.name: filesystem
capabilities.description: Read, write, and edit files on the local system

capabilities.name: git
capabilities.description: Git operations and conventions, layered on top of the shell capability.

capabilities.name: github
capabilities.description: GitHub integration — repos, issues, pull requests, branches, CI/Actions, code search, releases, gists, collaborators, labels, milestones, reviews, notifications, stars, forks, and more via the GitHub API

capabilities.name: google

capabilities.name: introspect
capabilities.description: Check Wolffish's own status, performance, and memory

capabilities.name: mcp
capabilities.description: Manage Wolffish's MCP (Model Context Protocol) server connections — list, add, test, enable, disable, remove, and sign in to the external tool servers whose tools become available to you. Changes reflect live in Settings → MCP.

capabilities.name: memes
capabilities.description: Find, generate, and share memes and GIFs. Can create custom captioned memes from popular templates or search for reaction GIFs.

capabilities.name: node
capabilities.description: Node.js runtime and npm package manager

capabilities.name: notion
capabilities.description: Read, create, update, and manage Notion pages, databases, and blocks

capabilities.name: operating-manual
capabilities.description: Your full working discipline for any real task. The operating_manual tool loads it — call that FIRST on anything complex, high-stakes, multi-step, or ambiguous, before any other tool.

capabilities.name: package-manager
capabilities.description: Cross-platform system package manager. Uses Homebrew on macOS (auto-installs if missing), winget on Windows (pre-installed), apt on Debian/Ubuntu, dnf on Fedora/RHEL.

capabilities.name: pdf
capabilities.description: Read, create, modify, merge, split, secure, and compress PDF documents

capabilities.name: procedures
capabilities.description: Manage Wolffish's saved procedures — reusable prompts the user runs on demand from the Procedures page. List, view, create, edit, delete, and run them.

capabilities.name: projects
capabilities.description: Manage the user's projects — shared instructions and file lists that fresh conversations start from — and see each project's conversations

capabilities.name: python
capabilities.description: Hermetic Python runtime (uv-managed CPython) for native Python plugins

capabilities.name: secrets
capabilities.description: Save and list the user's secrets and variables (Settings > Variables) — API keys, tokens, base URLs, and other reusable values

capabilities.name: shell
capabilities.description: Execute shell commands on the local system

capabilities.name: skills
capabilities.description: Manage and create Wolffish's own skills (capabilities) — list, search, enable, disable, delete, and author brand-new skills at runtime

capabilities.name: speech-to-text
capabilities.description: Transcribe audio files into text using faster-whisper (CTranslate2). Supports 99+ languages with automatic detection. Runs entirely locally — no API keys, no cloud, fully offline after setup.

capabilities.name: spreadsheet
capabilities.description: Read, create, modify, analyze, and convert spreadsheet files (xlsx, csv, tsv)

capabilities.name: system
capabilities.description: Open and close applications, open files/folders/URLs, and control machine power (restart, shutdown, sleep, lock, logout)

capabilities.name: text-to-speech
capabilities.description: Generate voice memos from text using a fully local neural TTS engine (Kokoro). Convert any text to spoken audio, respond with voice memos, or create voice summaries — entirely on-device, no cloud.

capabilities.name: utilities
capabilities.description: Small built-in utility tools that don't belong to a bigger capability — delivering files to the user as attachments, and pushing openable folder/file location cards.

capabilities.name: web-search
capabilities.description: Search the web and read web pages for current information, documentation, news, and research

capabilities.name: workflow
capabilities.description: Design and drive a model-led workflow — declare phases, spawn live parallel agents on models you choose, collect each result as it lands, and steer or cancel agents. Available only to the workflow master; agents never get these tools.
